description: Hooks for the Sovereign Implementer plugin. SessionStart injects the universal behavioural rules at session start (and on resume/clear/compact), detects project phase, and directs Claude to read the correct procedure doc. PreToolUse runs seven checks on Edit/Write/MultiEdit (locked-doc read-only, Serves-line resolution, batch file-list boundary, read-before-edit gate, test-confirmation gate during build phase, project-boundary, adoption gate) plus a Bash/PowerShell write-guard (V83 — blocks file-write patterns targeting denied paths) and a git safety guard on Bash (blocks git reset --hard and git push --force — V34). PostToolUse validates structured doc format after edits (BACKLOG parse, scope-context, TEST-LOG columns, build-log sections, proxy headers — V82). PreCompact blocks compaction when a build batch is in progress and recommends the user ask Claude to prepare a handoff before starting a fresh session (V52). UserPromptSubmit classifies the user's first prompt of a session into a routing category and injects the classification as context (V52).
